q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_plan_1 mideast) predicates the proper-noun modifier 'Mideast' of the plan, but the compound rules bar exposing a noun modifier at all (it stays inside the symbol) and a proper noun would also require its own Name atom.
(Member west_bank region) types the named place with a kind word the sentence never supplies — no kind noun sits inside or beside 'the West Bank', so nothing in the text puts this atom there.
the appositive 'an Israeli obligation' is collapsed into the status operator (Obligated sk_tear_down_1), which silently drops 'Israeli' — whose obligation it is gets no atom anywhere in the parse.

q2_gaps: a nominal appositive predicated of the preceding CLAUSE / eventuality ('X began doing Y - an Israeli obligation under Z') — the appositive rule covers only an entity appositive taking the host clause's tense wrapper
no holder slot on a deontic: (Obligated e) records that an act is obligatory but cannot say on whom the obligation falls, so 'an ISRAELI obligation' is unrepresentable
notes: The inception pattern (begin event + Ongoing activity, phrasal tear_down kept whole with no genus) and the fused nationality classifier israeli_soldier riding the group's kind slot both follow the instruction set; the activity carries no Past, matching the worked example even though the prose says 'both Past if past'.
